own_site_note: CORRECTION vs initial assumption: shookcolorbar.com is indeed a parked GoDaddy lander (confirmed via curl, redirects to /lander), but a SEPARATE domain www.shookcolor.com is a live, active, real Wix-built website for this exact business (same address 1403 Main St Dunedin FL 34698, same phones for Shey Gourley 727-831-6687 and Bridgette McAbee 727-418-3091, About page matches Booksy owner/staff data verbatim). This means has_own_site must be TRUE, not false. shookcolorbarsalon.com does not resolve (502).
fail_reason: Two independent stop conditions: (1) business already has a real, live, own website (www.shookcolor.com, Wix) discovered during research, which was not known when this job was queued as a no-website prospect; building a 'we made you a free site' demo would be false framing and contradicts PIPELINE.md's hard rule against claiming 'no website' when one exists. (2) Photo shortage: only 2 real photos exist total (Booksy dossier bk-1, IG rescue bk-2), and BOTH are forbidden for gallery use per DESIGN.md curation rules: bk-1 is a stylist selfie/portrait (only allowed as small avatar in an experience section, never a gallery tile) and bk-2 is an Instagram Reel/Story screenshot with UI stickers and a heart icon/progress bar overlay (forbidden as 'captura con texto/caption encima'). That leaves zero usable gallery photos, below the 4-photo minimum threshold to proceed. Site not built; no outreach draft or dm_message produced.
